deep_cfr_seat_assignment: Red StrategyNetwork plays Red; Blue StrategyNetwork plays Blue in every orientation and self-play condition
game_step_definition: one GameEngine.step by either player; maximum counts Red and Blue decisions together

policy_modes.Deep CFR: sample from current legal, normalized StrategyNetwork average-strategy probabilities
policy_modes.LSTM-PPO: masked categorical probabilities, deterministic argmax, independent per-seat hidden/cell state

seed_policy.game_deck_seed: base seed + game index; paired across orientations and matchups
seed_policy.policy_rng: stable BLAKE2-derived independent NumPy Generator for each game, orientation, seat, algorithm, and player instance
seed_policy.python_random: temporarily seeded only for initialization deck shuffles and restored immediately afterward
